item.title: Quantinuum and Oracle Partner to Bring Helios Quantum Computer to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
item.summary: Trapped-ion quantum hardware developer Quantinuum (NASDAQ: QNT) and Oracle Corporation (NYSE: ORCL) have announced a multi-year strategic partnership to deploy Quantinuum's 98-qubit Helios processor directly inside a U.S.-based Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) AI data center. The collaboration will make Helios available as a managed OCI quantum service, integrating trapped-ion quantum processing units (QPUs) alongside OCI’s [...] The post Quantinuum and Oracle Partner to Bring Helios Quantum Computer to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure appeared first on Quantum Computing Report .
